steps.en: Officer opens an Excel upload page for summon numbers or IDs
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman upload Excel untuk nomor summon atau ID
steps.why_en: The page is the general notice search upload, not a house visit screen.
steps.why_id: Halaman ini upload pencarian notice umum, bukan layar house visit.

steps.en: Officer uploads an Excel file of summon numbers or IDs using the template
steps.id: Officer upload file Excel berisi nomor summon atau ID memakai template

steps.en: Each row's format is validated before checking
steps.id: Format tiap baris divalidasi sebelum dicek

steps.en: OCMS uses the row's summon number or ID to find the related notices
steps.id: OCMS memakai nomor summon atau ID di baris untuk cari notice terkait
steps.why_en: Summon numbers are checked in the file but not used in the search, so a summon-only row finds the wrong notices.
steps.why_id: Nomor summon dicek di file tapi tidak dipakai saat mencari, jadi baris khusus summon salah hasil.
